changelog.body:
### Fixed

- Fixed Incode crash when passing selfie KYC (ART View Sync companion module required).

### Changed

- Migrated from the legacy Xposed API (82) to libxposed API (101).

No other changes.

**Requires an LSPosed build with modern-API (>=101) support.** Older Xposed/EdXposed and pre-modern-API LSPosed releases will not load this module.

Add **IncodeHook** — bypasses the Incode Welcome SDK anti-tamper gate that blocked KYC document verification ("No se pudo validar tu identidad") on Xposed/rooted devices. Tested on Prex 10.72.00 and 10.74.00.

First release.

Two patches for the Prex (Uruguay) app on de-googled / rooted devices:

- **RootHook** - forces RootBeer and IRoot checks to "not rooted", suppressing the "Dispositivo está rooteado" rejection on startup.
- **FirebaseFix** - makes the Capacitor Firebase plugin's `getAppInstanceId` return a stable non-empty value, so the `Device-Firebase-Instance-Id` login header isn't null (otherwise the app shows "Algo salió mal").

Scope: `air.Prex`, main process only. Tested on Android 15 + Magisk + Zygisk + LSPosed.

readme: > ⚠️ Installing unknown patches for banking apps is usually a very bad idea. Read and understand the code! # Prex Compat Xposed module to make the [Prex Uruguay](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.Prex) app work on de-googled / rooted devices. ## Hooks - **RootHook** — forces RootBeer (`com.scottyab.rootbeer`) and IRoot (`de.cyberkatze.iroot`) checks to "not rooted", suppressing "Dispositivo está rooteado" rejection on startup. - **FirebaseFix** — makes the Capacitor Firebase plugin's `getAppInstanceId` resolve a stable non-empty string, so the `Device-Firebase-Instance-Id` request header isn't null. Without this, the login POST is rejected client-side and the app shows "Algo salió mal" (likely a bug, introduced around `10.70.00`). ### KYC Incode’s device checks can reject rooted devices or crash when LSPosed is loaded. - **IncodeHook** skips the legacy environment gate and reads `SessionConfig.externalToken` directly to avoid a crash in its protected getter. It preserves the token, including null. - **[ART View Sync](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.prexcompat/blob/main/art-view-sync/README.md)** is a companion Magisk module. It gives the app a copy of `libart.so` matching its live ART memory, allowing Incode’s file comparison to pass with LSPosed loaded. Document capture, liveness checks, uploads, and server verification are unchanged. ## Tested configurations Requires an LSPosed build with modern Xposed API 101 support. Tested on Android 15/16/17 (LineageOS) with Magisk, Zygisk, and LSPosed. Additional root hiding tools such as Shamiko are not required. Active app versions: - `10.80.00` - Working with PrexCompat. - `10.79.00` - Working with PrexCompat. Selfie KYC verified. Older versions are disabled by Prex. Not tested on other regional variants — [Argentina](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.PrexArgentina), [Chile](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.PrexChile), [Peru](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.PrexPeru). PRs are welcome. ## Source [github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.prexcompat](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.prexcompat) ## Install Install the APK and enable the module in LSPosed, then force-stop the app. Scope is fixed to `air.Prex` (`staticScope=true` via `META-INF/xposed/scope.list`), so no manual scope selection is needed. If you're running Magisk with "Enforce DenyList" enabled — remove Prex from this list to allow Xposed injection. If app requests selfie verification to pass KYC: - Install ART View Sync module, reboot - Pass the KYC in Prex - Disable or uninstall module, reboot ## License [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.prexcompat/blob/main/LICENSE)
